summary: Georgia's list places a Fletcher Branch tower in Long County at an elevation listed as 71 with no unit; no source found on its build, use or present state.

evidence.supports: List entry for Fletcher Branch Lookout Tower in Long County, elevation 71, tagged gfc-130
The list's map was last revised in March 2016
GFC history says the first fire observation tower in its account was erected on the Ware Hotel in Waycross
evidence.quote: tower was erected on the Ware Hotel in Waycross, and another was erected on top of a city water supply

evidence.supports: GFC history ties that tower, perhaps, to a 1928 forestry fair in Waycross
evidence.quote: Perhaps as a direct consequence of a 1928 Forestry Fair held in Waycross

sources.title: History of the Georgia Forestry Commission

notes_for_editor: Very thin record. Only the state list entry (coordinates, elevation 71, tag gfc-130, page revised March 2016) and general GFC history were usable. A topo-map site listing this tower as 'Long Lookout Tower' returned HTTP 403 and was not used. Two web searches found nothing on its build, staffing, status or access. The list states no elevation unit; the story reads 71 as feet (about 22 m) and says so. The gfc-130 tag matches the brief's GFC US 130 register number, but the sources do not explain the tag. Worth asking Georgia Forestry Commission for the tower's history and checking whether it still stands.
